gloss: brunt; target (of an attack or criticism); spearhead

definitions.gloss: brunt; target (of an attack or criticism); spearhead
definitions.explanation: Literally the point of a spear. Used mostly for the direction in which an attack, criticism, or anger is aimed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{矛先|ほこさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いた→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: The criticism was turned on me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{矛先|ほこさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}ける→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧よく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It's wrong to vent your anger on your subordinates.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{矛先|ほこさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The reporters shifted the thrust of their questions from the minister to the company president.
